seo.title: Md Sumon Howlader — Founder, Durbin Films
seo.description: Md Sumon Howlader founded Durbin Films in 2021 and is the Editor and Publisher of Durbin News, the PID registered portal. A Dhaka producer building for a Bengali audience online since 2014.

name: Md Sumon Howlader
intro: A producer who has worked online full time since 2014. He founded Durbin Films in October 2021 and Durbin News four months later, and runs both from Dhaka, Bangladesh.

profile.heading: Ten years of one audience
paragraphs: Md Sumon Howlader has worked on the internet full time since 2014, well before a Bengali audience moved to YouTube in the numbers it has now. More than two thousand projects have gone out of his hands since then, most of them short films and documentaries, and that volume taught him the thing a producer cannot be told and has to learn for himself: what people give their attention to, and what they scroll past.

He founded Durbin Films in October 2021. The studio's work now runs across three YouTube channels with more than two and a half million subscribers between them, and its drama has gone out on television as well as online. He produces across the slate, from picking the story and setting the budget through to final delivery.

Four months after the studio, he launched Durbin News, which the Press Information Department registered as an online news portal in July 2022. He is its Editor and Publisher. The newsroom and the studio share one office in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

items.title: Started working online full time
items.text: Began as a freelancer building digital projects, which became the base for everything after.

items.title: Durbin Films founded
items.text: Started the studio and moved into production: television drama, web series, commercials and brand films, produced end to end.

items.title: Durbin News founded
items.text: Launched the portal and built it into a government registered online news outlet with a national readership and a set of Durbin branded pages.

items.title: Both ventures registered
items.text: Durbin Films became a registered company on 1 July 2022. On 31 July 2022 Durbin News received its Press Information Department registration as online news portal no. 147.

items.name: Durbin Films
items.text: A Dhaka production house making television drama, web series, short films and brand work end to end. Founded October 2021.

items.name: Durbin News
items.text: Government registered online news portal (PID no. 147), launched February 2022, with a national readership and daily coverage.

quote.text: A newsroom taught me what people skip. Production is just doing the opposite.
